headline.purpose: Page title: the clinic name or page heading.

label.purpose: Secondary lines, form labels, freshness notes.

motion.name: state-change
motion.purpose: Hover and focus color changes only; reduced motion respected.

components.name: Primary Button (owner size)
components.description: The main action on a screen, e.g. Call. 44px minimum height on owner and clinic screens.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 20px; background: var(--primary); color: var(--primary-foreground); border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 0.75rem; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary) 80%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary) 50%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary actions next to the primary one (Messenger, Directions).
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 20px; background: var(--background); color: var(--foreground); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 0.75rem; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--muted); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary) 50%, transparent); } .ds-btn-outline:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Form field with a visible label; 16px text so iOS does not zoom.
components.css: .ds-field { font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; } .ds-field-label { font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--foreground); } .ds-input { font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; height: 44px; padding: 0 12px; font-size: 1rem; color: var(--foreground); background: transparent; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 0.75rem; transition: border-color 150ms; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--muted-foreground); } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: var(--primary); outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Card
components.description: White surface with a hairline ring; tint (muted/accent) groups content before any shadow.
components.css: .ds-card { font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; padding: 16px; background: var(--background); color: var(--foreground); border-radius: 1.05rem; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in oklch, var(--foreground) 10%, transparent); } .ds-card-title { font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 500; } .ds-card-body { margin: 0; font-size: 1rem; }

components.name: Quick Chip
components.description: Search shortcut on home and results (Open now, Kapon, Bakuna, species).
components.css: .ds-chip { font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; background: var(--muted); color: var(--foreground); border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 9999px; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms; } .ds-chip:hover { background: var(--border); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Emergency Chip
components.description: Always-visible entry to the emergency view (UX7). The only use of the emergency color besides that view.
components.css: .ds-chip-emergency { font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; background: var(--emergency); color: var(--primary-foreground); border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 9999px; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; } .ds-chip-emergency:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--emergency) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Open Status
components.description: OpenStatusText + HoursFreshness: status as icon + text + color, with the freshness line underneath (UX4, UX5).
components.html:
Open· closes 6 PM

Hours confirmed 5 days ago by the clinic
components.css: .ds-status { font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; color: var(--foreground); font-size: 1rem; } .ds-status-line { margin: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; } .ds-status-icon { display: inline-flex; color: var(--status-open); } .ds-status-label { font-weight: 600; color: var(--status-open); } .ds-status-fresh { margin: 0; font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--muted-foreground); }

narrative.overview:
PAW is the local who has already called around: they know which clinic is open right now, which one sees rabbits, and roughly what a kapon costs, and they tell you plainly. Warm, local and word-of-mouth in feel, but the facts are exact and dated. Friendliness comes from soft shapes, warm tints and plain words, never from cartoons, mascots or jokes.

Density depends on the audience (UX14). Owner pages are mobile-first at 360 px and say one thing at a time: status, distance, Call. The clinic dashboard has big forgiving controls, one task per screen. /admin is dense and desktop-first, with shadcn defaults. In an emergency the warmth steps back and only the facts and actions remain.
keyCharacteristics: Status first: open / closing / closed / unknown, always as text + icon + color.
Freshness is always visible ("Hours confirmed 5 days ago by the clinic").
Soft, rounded, friendly surfaces on a white page; color is kept for status and actions.
Light: the system font, no decorative images, a map only when asked for.

rules.name: The Meaning-Only Color Rule
rules.body: Status, stale, verified and emergency colors mean exactly one thing each. Never use them for decoration, and never show status by color alone (UX4).

rules.name: The Token-Only Rule
rules.body: Components use the Tailwind classes these tokens produce (bg-primary, text-status-open), never raw values. Changing the brand is an edit to globals.css only.

rules.name: The 16px Floor Rule
rules.body: Owner-facing body text is never below 1rem. text-sm is for secondary lines only, and never for a phone number, a price or a status.

rules.name: The Tint-Before-Shadow Rule
rules.body: To group or lift content, use a tinted surface first. A shadow is only for something that really floats above the page.

dos: Do show status as text + icon + color, and freshness with its source, wherever hours appear.
Do keep the main action (Call) primary-colored, in the thumb zone, and at least 44px tall on owner and clinic screens.
Do use muted / accent tints to group content before reaching for borders or shadows.
Do pair every icon with a visible label (DESIGN §2, principle 6).
donts: Don't use raw color values, or status colors for decoration.
Don't add mascots, cartoon illustrations, pet puns or emoji: friendly, not childish (DESIGN §7).
Don't add motion, hero images or extra client JavaScript to owner pages without a reason; the performance budget (DESIGN §9) is for mid-range Android on mobile data.
Don't put anything in the emergency view except open-now, distance and Call (UX7).
